name: East Ridge
why: Reached from a glacier landing and climbs steep snow with crevasses on the way, on the Mount Logan massif.

name: Hummingbird Ridge
why: The ridge rises from the big glaciers of the Logan massif and is approached across crevassed glacier.

name: King Trench
why: Its own text calls for standard glacier-travel equipment.

name: Unnamed peak - Honeymoon Arete
why: The approach says to cross a short glacier to reach the climb.

name: The Wizard
why: A bergschrund and a 60 degree snow couloir with a cornice are stated, but a search could not confirm the glacier below.
secondReview: yes/yes: Couloir above a bergschrund in a glaciated Boundary Ranges massif.

name: Vulcan Mountain
why: No text, and a search found nothing on this peak, so neither fact could be checked.
research: yes/yes: The route page describes crossing the Vulcan Glacier to the summit with a bergschrund, icefall and glacier gear, in early to mid July snow.
